name: rederived
description: RC11's sources with each element whose design followed the third-party 4.1.1b DLL replaced by its independent re-derivation from the SDK 2.3.0 code, where one exists. A comparison build: built by dll/build.py --config rederived; checked by dll/port/rederive.py. The RC12 release (dll/rc12.json) builds on it.

provenance.final-pass-divisions: Re-derived from the SDK 2.3.0 code alone (2026-10-23): dll/port/sdiv_shift.py cannot prove the dividend of any of the final pass's power-of-two signed divisions non-negative from the IR (they divide constant-buffer fields), so every one stays sdiv. RC9-RC11 replaced two of them with logical shifts in slot 0x248220; this configuration restores the SDK's instructions there.
provenance.int8-eligibility: Not re-derived: two attempts at an independent derivation (2026-10-23) did not complete. This configuration applies no edit at the site and keeps the SDK's bytes, so its DLL does not offer the INT8 provider on non-RDNA4 GPUs. The RC12 release (dll/rc12.json) applies RC11's edit unchanged (decision of 2026-10-24); see dll/notices/PROVENANCE.md.
